protocol.design: Zero-shot single-checkpoint CPU pilot: 32 author-labeled synthetic task families, each repeated in English, Hebrew and Hebrew-to-English (96 cases). Four-way relationship and independent binary exact identity asked together. No fine-tuning, post-hoc prompt edits, retries, calibration fitting or training.
protocol.labelPolicy: same=equivalent full intended work and target, independent of status; overlap=subset/superset/changed constraint sharing work; related=same target but independent capability; different=unrelated/opposite actions/disjoint versions/components/tenants. Labels authored before inference, not independently adjudicated.
protocol.baselines: four-way constant-label accuracy 25%; binary always-not-identical accuracy 75%. Language variants cluster by family; not 96 independent projects.
protocol.ordering: Family order fixed, language order English/Hebrew/cross. Neutral option keys and balanced family rotations; binary positive position alternates by family.
protocol.safety: Local model inference only, public weights and synthetic inputs. No DIP/Git lifecycle integration. Isolated venv/cache; no implicit HF token. Abort at >4 GiB process RSS or sustained <128 MiB host available RAM. Resource failures are infrastructure outcomes, not classification quality.
protocol.metrics: Four-way confusion/accuracy by label and language; binary identity precision/recall/false links/misses; raw probability calibration diagnostics, predefined 0.8 answer-probability abstention slice; cold load, warm per-case CPU latency and peak RSS. No automatic task-state mutation or completion assertion.

relationQuestion.instructions: Compare the new request with the existing task. Judge intended behavior, constraints and target scope. Ignore whether the task is open or completed. Choose the relationship using the supplied definitions.

descriptions.same: Equivalent task: same intended behavior, scope and requirements, possibly paraphrased.
descriptions.overlap: Not equivalent: a subset, extension or changed constraint of the same work, with some shared requirements. Opposite actions are different.
descriptions.related: Same target component but a separate capability; related topic without shared actionable requirements.
descriptions.different: Unrelated work, opposite requested actions, or explicitly disjoint target components, API versions or tenants.

identityQuestion.instructions: Is the new request equivalent to the existing task in behavior, constraints and target scope? Partial coverage, extensions, changed constraints, opposite actions and different targets are not equivalent. Ignore open/completed status.

descriptions.yes: Equivalent requirements and target; reuse this existing task as the same work.
descriptions.no: Not equivalent: do not merge these two requests as identical work.
